column1: # The checks of shell/auth3-checks.nsh, the Shell boot of shell-auth3-checks: EnhancedAuthData,
# EnhancedAuthRefused and EnhancedAuthNonce have the attributes 0x87. See check-shell-log.sh.
# DmpStore shows each as seeded: 68 bytes of metadata and 4 of data, or 64 and 4 for the nonce
# variable info shows the metadata of the nonce-type variable, and why it refuses that of
# Version 2, from the data that GetVariable() returns (UEFI 2.11 section 8.2.1)
# a TimeStamp that is not later than the variable's is refused before any write
